description: A braceless `if (c) a; else b` inside an engine state-child `effect=${…}` and inside an `<onTransition>` `${…}` body keeps its `else`: with `@n == 0` the effect on Idle→Busy writes `neg` (not `pos`), and the Busy→Idle onTransition appends `N` (not `P`).
rationale: §51.0.H effect bodies are logic; §17 if/else — `else` belongs to its braceless `if`.
